comment: Engine-game launch STRATEGY routing - droidtop-authored (no upstream frontend maintains these). Names match droidtop's GameLaunchStrategy enum, in priority order: ENGINEHOST launches via the enginehost app's LAUNCH intent; WINE_PREFIX and LINUX_CONTAINER run through droidtop's internal gamenative-derived runtime (runtime-windows WineSession / NativeLinuxGameSession), never a separate app. Engine EMULATORS (EasyRPG, Kirikiroid2, Ruffle, ...) are NOT declared here: engines are systems, and apps that emulate engines live in players-database.json exactly like apps that emulate consoles (systemIds: easyrpg, kirikiri, flash, ...). JoiPlay is deliberately absent everywhere: it exposes no consumable launch surface.

engines.notes: Ren'Py ships py/sh/exe launchers together; Linux path preferred over Wine when both exist.
MV/MZ are nw.js exports; Linux only when the export includes it.

Primary path is the easyrpg PLAYER entries in players-database.json (engines are systems). DETECTION GAP: droidtop's GameEngineDetector does not classify RM2000/2003 folders yet (RPG_RT.exe/.ldb signature).
KIRIKIROID2 strategy predates the unified player entry; both point at the same app.
Plain .swf: the flash player entries in players-database.json (Ruffle etc.); AIR-packaged Windows builds fall back to Wine.
HTML export; enginehost's web runtime is the natural host.
Per-export: Linux build when shipped, else the Windows build under Wine.
